reading_note: The teaching describes how spiritual nourishment (truth and good received from the Lord) is taken into the regenerate person and divides into five distinct outputs corresponding to five degrees of expression: thought/perception ascending through the mind; confession in speech; works produced under power and shame; the conjugial delight between will and understanding; and finally the visible regenerate life formed in ultimates. Of these, the natural man knowingly desires and seeks only the last — the externally manifest fruit — while the four interior productions occur unperceived. The arc moves from receiving truth → its inward division → its emergence at every degree of the human form → the asymmetry between the one outward birth that is sought and the four hidden births that are not.
